artwork.prompt: Playlist cover artwork, square format, evocative rather than literal. A 2015-present cover. Medium: digital collage of cut-out photography over scanned paper texture. Subject: a modernist chair on tile. Palette: sand, sea green, sun yellow, white. Composition: layered and deliberately flat, elements overlapping at odd scales. No text, lettering, typography, watermarks, logos or signatures anywhere in the image.
